name: Kanishk Steel Industries Limited
about: Kanishk Steel Industries Limited manufactures and sells iron and steel products under the Kanishk Steels brand in India. The company offers thermo mechanically treated steel bars that are used in commercial and residential buildings, bridges, dams and power plants, and other concrete structures; and structural steel products, such as joists, I and H beams, channels, angles, squares, rounds, flats, CTD bars, wire rods, and profiles used for mining, tunnels construction, factory structures, transmission towers, bridges, ships, railways, and other infrastructure projects. It also provides sponge iron, which is used as a constituent in manufacturing steel and steel-related products. Kanishk Steel Industries Limited was incorporated in 1989 and is based in Chennai, India.
